opportunities.title: DPhil in Computer Science
opportunities.description: Official University of Oxford graduate admissions page describes the DPhil in Computer Science as a research-based course focused on original contributions in areas including algorithms, AI, quantum computing, cybersecurity, and software engineering. As of the official page check, the full-time course is Closed to applications for entry in 2026-27; the page instructs applicants to register to receive an email when applications open for entry in 2027-28. Expected length 3-4 years. Expected start date listed as October 2026 (for the 2026-27 entry information on the page). No application deadline date for 2027-28 was published on the page.
opportunities.eligibility: Official page includes an Entry requirements section for entry in 2026-27 (details expanded on the live page). English language level stated as Standard level required. Do not assume undergraduate eligibility; the DPhil is a graduate research degree.

opportunities.title: MSc in Advanced Computer Science
opportunities.description: Official University of Oxford graduate admissions page describes this as a full-time twelve-month taught MSc covering advanced topics including machine learning, computer security, quantum information, and formal verification. Students complete option modules and a dissertation; a specialist stream in Artificial Intelligence may be available subject to requirements. As of the official page check, the course is Closed to applications for entry in 2026-27; register for email when applications open for entry in 2027-28. Expected start date listed as October 2026. No 2027-28 deadline date was published.
opportunities.eligibility: Official materials state entrants come from a computer science or mathematical background. English language level stated as Higher level required. Entry requirements for 2026-27 are on the official page.
